objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: Possesses an exceptionally elongated neck that is significantly longer than the torso.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Structure: Features paired, skin-covered bony protuberances (ossicones) on the top of the head rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Proportion: Exhibits a steeply sloping backline where the forelegs are visibly taller than the hindlegs.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: Displays a mosaic of irregular, polygonal patches separated by lighter lines, distinct from the stripes of zebras or the solid colors of horses.
